build_json.note: BUILD.json records source=prebuilt because the zip was installed with --prebuilt; the zip itself was built locally, which is why results.json build_kind=source is correct and build_options wording is not

strata_setup.pr_title: [Other] Setup: --gpus on Windows AMD: RDNA 2, 3 and 4 cards sharing one model
strata_setup.role: lets setup accept a --gpus split across AMD families and accept a self-built multi-arch engine; it changes no inference code

why_no_official_engine: Official release v0.2.11 ships per-family Windows HIP engines only (strata-engine-0.1.57-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna2.tar.gz, -rdna3, -rx9070). No official Windows HIP asset carries code for both gfx1030 and gfx1201, so a 6800 XT + R9700 split cannot run on any single official engine download. A self-built multi-arch engine is the documented path (setup.py:4996).

model.revision_evidence: Hugging Face tree listing shows commit 3f3ba9c 'Better UD 3.1 quants' for all four shards; local shard byte sizes match the listing (10946618 / 49946027488 / 4869325888 / 28800138432). Size-level corroboration, not hash-level proof.
